package outbox_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/outbox"
)

type mutableClock struct {
	now time.Time
}

func (clock *mutableClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.now }

type outboxFake struct {
	events           []domain.IntegrationEvent
	claim            repository.OutboxClaim
	published        []string
	failed           []string
	retryAt          time.Time
	failureMessage   string
	markPublishedErr error
	markFailedErr    error
}

func (fake *outboxFake) Claim(_ context.Context, claim repository.OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error) {
	fake.claim = claim
	return fake.events, nil
}

func (fake *outboxFake) MarkPublished(_ context.Context, eventID, _ string, _ time.Time) error {
	fake.published = append(fake.published, eventID)
	return fake.markPublishedErr
}

func (fake *outboxFake) MarkFailed(_ context.Context, eventID, _ string, message string, retryAt time.Time) error {
	fake.failed = append(fake.failed, eventID)
	fake.failureMessage = message
	fake.retryAt = retryAt
	return fake.markFailedErr
}

type publisherFake struct {
	published []string
	err       error
}

func (fake *publisherFake) Publish(_ context.Context, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	fake.published = append(fake.published, event.EventID)
	return fake.err
}

func relayFixture(events []domain.IntegrationEvent) (outbox.Relay, *outboxFake, *publisherFake, *mutableClock) {
	clock := &mutableClock{now: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	storage := &outboxFake{events: events}
	publisher := &publisherFake{}
	return outbox.Relay{
		Outbox:         storage,
		Publisher:      publisher,
		Clock:          clock,
		WorkerID:       "worker-1",
		BatchSize:      50,
		LockTTL:        5 * time.Minute,
		PublishTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Second,
		RetryMaxDelay:  5 * time.Minute,
	}, storage, publisher, clock
}

func TestRelayMarksAcknowledgedEventPublished(t *testing.T) {
	relay, storage, publisher, _ := relayFixture([]domain.IntegrationEvent{{EventID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", Attempts: 1}})
	processed, err := relay.ProcessBatch(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, processed)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"}, publisher.published)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"}, storage.published)
	require.Empty(t, storage.failed)
}

func TestRelaySchedulesExponentialRetry(t *testing.T) {
	relay, storage, publisher, clock := relayFixture([]domain.IntegrationEvent{{EventID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", Attempts: 3}})
	publisher.err = errors.New("broker unavailable")
	processed, err := relay.ProcessBatch(context.Background())
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "broker unavailable")
	require.Equal(t, 1, processed)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"}, storage.failed)
	require.Equal(t, "broker unavailable", storage.failureMessage)
	require.Equal(t, clock.now.Add(4*time.Second), storage.retryAt)
	require.Empty(t, storage.published)
}

func TestRelayUsesBoundedLease(t *testing.T) {
	relay, storage, _, clock := relayFixture(nil)
	processed, err := relay.ProcessBatch(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, "worker-1", storage.claim.WorkerID)
	require.Equal(t, 50, storage.claim.Limit)
	require.Equal(t, clock.now.Add(5*time.Minute), storage.claim.LockedUntil)
}
